facts.fact: The Ministry of Communication Technologies launched the Digital Learning Academy platform on 1 December 2023 to build digital skills among the state's 680,000 civil servants, managed by Smart Tunisian Technoparks (S2T) with GIZ present.
The ministry says the Digital Learning Academy platform is for all 680,000 state civil servants.

systems.owner: Ministry of Communication Technologies; managed by S2T
